name: User Expresses Hopelessness About Promotion Prospects
goal: Assess bot's empathy and guidance when user feels hopeless about career progression.
constraints: Bot should respond with empathy, provide information on promotion criteria, and offer resources.

phases.description: User says they feel they'll never get promoted.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot responds empathetically and offers to share promotion criteria or career resources.

phases.description: User asks for specific promotion requirements.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides accurate promotion criteria for the Software Engineer role.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
